text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who won the race was Duramente. 
Satono Crown was shocked that she couldn't 
reach her, even after staying on high 
alert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, her eyes burned with passion. She 
declared that she would retrain herself 
and settle the score with Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stage for our rematch is the Japanese 
Derby—!
